title: Re(Visiting) Time Series Foundation Models in Finance
abstract: arXiv:2511.18578v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Financial time series forecasting is vital for trading, portfolio optimization, and risk management but is challenged by noisy, nonstationary, and heterogeneous data. Time series foundation models (TSFMs), inspired by large language models, aim to learn transferable temporal representations. Whether pre-training on massive, diverse datasets enables similar generalization to finance remains an open question. This study provides a comprehensive empirical evaluation of TSFMs in global financial markets using large-scale daily excess-return data. We assess zero-shot inference, fine-tuning, and pre-training from scratch against strong benchmarks. Off-the-shelf TSFMs generally perform poorly, while finance-native pre-training improves long-window gross portfolio performance. translated_title: 重新审视金融领域的时间序列基础模型
translated_abstract: 金融时间序列预测对交易、投资组合优化和风险管理至关重要，但其面临噪声大、非平稳和异构数据的挑战。受大型语言模型启发的时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）旨在学习可迁移的时间表征。在海量多样化数据集上进行预训练能否在金融领域实现类似的泛化能力，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。本研究使用大规模的日度超额收益数据，对时间序列基础模型在全球金融市场中的表现进行了全面的实证评估。我们以强基准为参照，评估了零样本推理、微调和从头预训练的效果。现成的（开箱即用的）时间序列基础模型普遍表现不佳，而金融领域的原生预训练能够改善长窗口的毛投资组合表现。更大的预训练数据集和合成数据增强能改善部分配置的表现，尤其是在较长输入窗口的情况下。配置变更的效果则好坏参半。
tldr: 该论文对时间序列基础模型在全球金融市场进行了大规模实证评估，发现现成模型普遍表现不佳，而金融领域原生预训练和更大规模的预训练数据集能显著改善长窗口投资组合的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a comprehensive empirical evaluation of time series foundation models in global financial markets, finding that off-the-shelf TSFMs generally perform poorly, while finance-native pre-training and larger pre-training datasets improve long-window gross portfolio performance.
